description: This file defines the TenantTraceSamplingHandler class, which is a Vert.x web handler responsible for determining tenant information from the request context and applying tenant-specific tracing sample configurations using OpenTracing spans.

classes.name: TenantTraceSamplingHandler
classes.description: A Vert.x web handler that manages tenant context extraction and applies trace sampling configuration based on tenant info.

methods.name: TenantTraceSamplingHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the handler with a provider for tenant and auth ID information.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the incoming RoutingContext, retrieves trace span, fetches tenant info, and applies trace sampling.

methods.name: getTracingHandlerServerSpan
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve the current trace span from the RoutingContext or return a noop span if not available.
